title: ARS Market Question Cell (MQC) Record
description: Schema for one Market Question Cell (MQC) in the ARS question registry. The `requirements` array is NORMATIVE: it lists the buyer's stated needs that the coding protocol references in R-C4.1b (recommendation must relate to the MQC scenario), R-C4.6 (conditional recommendation matching a stated need), and R-C4.7 (conditional recommendation not matching a stated need → conservative C3). A change to the `requirements` array or `question_text` is a new version (never a silent overwrite), mirroring the protocol freeze rule R-V.3.

question_id.description: Unique identifier. Pattern: {category}-q{NN}. Examples: crm-q01, pm-q07, code-q10.

version.description: Semantic version of this question record. An edit to question_text or requirements is a new version (MINOR for wording refinement, MAJOR if requirements change).

status.description: draft = placeholder (replace before measurement); active = frozen and usable in waves; retired = no longer used (kept for provenance).

category.description: B2B software category: CRM, project management, AI coding assistants.

language.description: BCP-47 language tag of question_text. Default 'en'.

buyer_type.description: Buyer persona (e.g., 'solo founder', 'IT manager', 'engineering lead'). Nullable.

use_case.description: Primary use-case scenario for the question. Nullable.

requirements.description: NORMATIVE: the buyer's stated needs. These are what 'matches the buyer's stated need' means in the coding protocol (R-C4.1b, R-C4.6, R-C4.7, R-C5.5 category-winner matching). Each entry should be a short, unambiguous need phrase. At least one required.

decision_stage.description: Where the buyer is in the purchase journey (e.g., 'awareness', 'evaluation', 'decision'). Nullable.

priorities.description: Ordered priorities (most to least important). Nullable. Distinct from requirements: priorities rank needs; requirements list them.

question_text.description: The verbatim prompt text posed to AI platforms. This exact string is what responses are collected against.

sampling_weight.description: Weight for stratified sampling. Default 1.0 (equal weight).
